name: sirlouen/gpx-route-map
description: Render a GPX track as an interactive OpenStreetMap map with waypoints, distance and an elevation profile.

scripts.seed: pnpm exec wp-env run cli wp --require=wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/tools/seeder.php gpxrm seed
scripts.seed:fresh: pnpm exec wp-env run cli wp --require=wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/tools/seeder.php gpxrm seed --fresh
